done
echo "--- exemptions ---"
grep -n "phase-2-sweeps-contract" lib/test/reference-size-exemptions.json 2>/dev/null || echo "no exemption row"

python3 lib/test/lint-reference-size.py 2>&1 | tail -20 || true
